title: AnythingLLM v1.17.0
body_markdown:
## What's Changed


- fix(collector): read spreadsheet dates as dates, not serial numbers by[@L4XB](https://github.com/L4XB) in[#6478](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6478)
- Drop temp param for Anthropic models by[@shatfield4](https://github.com/shatfield4) in[#6472](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6472)
- Allow Generic OpenAI max tokens of 0 to omit max_tokens from request by[@shatfield4](https://github.com/shatfield4) in[#6470](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6470)
- fix: support SearchApi engines in agent web browsing by[@evilive3000](https://github.com/evilive3000) in[#6465](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6465)
- fix: ignore malformed agent WebSocket frames instead of crashing the server by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#6493](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6493)
- fix(collector): read an HTML-only mbox message instead of skipping it by[@L4XB](https://github.com/L4XB) in[#6484](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6484)
- fix(collector): read text uploads in the encoding they were written in by[@L4XB](https://github.com/L4XB) in[#6486](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6486)
- fix(weaviate, astra): score chunks by cosine similarity like the other providers by[@L4XB](https://github.com/L4XB) in[#6488](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6488)
- fix(bedrock): support OpenAI models on AWS by[@hahahahahayesyeseys](https://github.com/hahahahahayesyeseys) in[#6473](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6473)
- fix: fetch Kokoro voices from the same base path speech uses by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6459](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6459)
- feat(togetherai): allow configuring max_tokens to prevent response truncation by[@imanecdoche](https://github.com/imanecdoche) in[#6463](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6463)
- fix: reset vectors and warn when the Azure embedding deployment changes by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6461](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6461)
- fix: keep manually set env settings when a settings save rewrites .env by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6457](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6457)
- fix: use the workspace refusal text when an embed has no documents by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6454](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6454)
- fix: export only the chats the chat window shows by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6452](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6452)
- fix: keep every sheet of a multi-sheet XLSX upload by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6450](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6450)
- Include generated images in chat exports by[@shatfield4](https://github.com/shatfield4) in[#6482](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6482)
- feat: add Firecrawl agent web-search provider by[@JuampiHernandez](https://github.com/JuampiHernandez) in[#6480](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6480)
- Autosave workspace settings on edit by[@shatfield4](https://github.com/shatfield4) in[#6343](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6343)
- Add keyboard navigation and autofocus to provider search menus by[@shatfield4](https://github.com/shatfield4) in[#6483](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6483)
- Read Anthropic replies from text blocks, not the first block by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#6496](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6496)
- fix: keep Telegram link URLs intact when they contain markdown characters by[@MohammadHijjawi97](https://github.com/MohammadHijjawi97) in[#6524](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6524)
- feat: add Gemini as an image generation provider by[@petre](https://github.com/petre) in[#6520](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6520)
- fix(ui): use dynamic viewport height for mobile sidebar drawers by[@albiea](https://github.com/albiea) in[#6518](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6518)
- fix: keep compressed RAG context when the prompt or a chunk says "Context:" by[@breken-ai](https://github.com/breken-ai) in[#6503](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6503)
- fix: skip emoji when reading a message aloud by[@SulimanAbdulrazzaq](https://github.com/SulimanAbdulrazzaq) in[#6500](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6500)
- fix: clear the workspace router when switching back to the system default by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6506](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6506)
- fix: skip saving an embed chat when the reply came back empty by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6508](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6508)
- fix: let users and admins clear a bio by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6510](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6510)
- fix: resolve relative links against the page they appear on when crawling deeper by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6512](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6512)
- fix: keep each mbox message's own title when an upload supplies one by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6514](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6514)
- Add llmman image generation provider by[@shatfield4](https://github.com/shatfield4) in[#6497](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6497)
- fix: let Milvus and Zilliz embed into workspaces whose slug starts with a digit by[@wenqiw777](https://github.com/wenqiw777) in[#6527](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6527)
- fix: filter Google Calendar skill in multi-user mode and apply its disabled sub-skills by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#6539](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6539)
- fix: keep Confluence code blocks whose macro does not list ac:name first by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6530](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6530)
- fix: embed every document an API upload returns into addToWorkspaces by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6532](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6532)
- fix: keep IPs, versions and decimal commas as text in created Excel files by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6534](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6534)
- fix: only run Telegram bot commands at the start of a message by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6536](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6536)
- fix: send the Keep Alive setting on agent requests to Ollama and llmman by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6538](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6538)
- fix(mobile): reject unknown threadSlug on reset-chat and stream-chat by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#6540](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6540)
- fix: render c++, ~~~ and nested fenced code as code in Telegram replies by[@huiq777](https://github.com/huiq777) in[#6547](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6547)
- fix: decode DuckDuckGo result links once and strip HTML from titles by[@simonether](https://github.com/simonether) in[#6544](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6544)
- Clean up TTS text for cloud voices and Telegram voice replies by[@shatfield4](https://github.com/shatfield4) in[#6552](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6552)
- fix: use each workspace's prompt and id in JSONL and Alpaca chat exports by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6551](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6551)
- Rotate empty chat greetings by time of day by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#6567](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6567)
- fix: mask the saved LiteLLM API key and save changes to it by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6556](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6556)
- fix: shift the weekday and day of month of scheduled jobs across UTC midnight by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6558](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6558)
- fix: load Fireworks models and Kokoro voices with the saved API key by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6557](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6557)
- fix: give each new agent flow block its own id by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6560](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6560)
- fix: save turning password protection off so it survives a restart by[@marmar9615-cloud](https://github.com/marmar9615-cloud) in[#6562](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6562)
- fix: save links whose URL path cannot be percent-decoded by[@MohammadHijjawi97](https://github.com/MohammadHijjawi97) in[#6565](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6565)
- fix: use the embed's message history limit when the model router is on by[@MohammadHijjawi97](https://github.com/MohammadHijjawi97) in[#6566](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6566)
- fix: stop filesystem-edit-file expanding $ patterns in newText by[@wenqiw777](https://github.com/wenqiw777) in[#6569](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6569)
- fix: parse developer API document attachments for agent chats by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#6573](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6573)
- fix: keep uploaded images when switching from chat to[@agent](https://github.com/agent) mid-session by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#6572](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6572)
- Apply workspace temperature to agents and omit the parameter when unset by[@shatfield4](https://github.com/shatfield4) in[#6285](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6285)
- Reasoning effort controls by[@shatfield4](https://github.com/shatfield4) in[#6269](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6269)
